reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x005236C0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/weatherwatersky/005236C0-WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0.cpp at sha256 1f4dd9ea76f631af54599bca4ef4d75ef7a3315372466fae172aff9aaeb19ca6 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t __convention WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, int32_t* param_3, void* param_4);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0
retail_function.signature: int32_t __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, int32_t* arg3, void* arg4)
retail_function.summary: 15 blocks / 22 edges 0x5236C0-0x5237DC: remove the object at [E+4] from the dynobj list, clear/release the light pointer at [obj+0xC8], walk the lightmap list at [obj+0x88] (stride 0x24) sampling and clearing each entry, dispatch through the 0x180-stride handler table g_a96ae0 with the byte index g_547f3d masked by 0xFF and the WORD at [frame+0x1C], then update the lightmap free list (g_a83a08/g_a83a04/g_a83a14) and optionally unload 0xA83B54.

candidate_function.signature: int32_t __convention WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, int32_t* param_3, void* param_4);
candidate_function.summary: WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0 transcribes the whole body, but uses the full dword of g_547f3d for the dispatch index and reads a dword at [ecx+0x1C] where retail reads a zero-extended word.

divergences: Dispatch index is not masked with 0xFF: retail `and eax,0xff` at 0x523738 before the 0x180-stride table lookup; the candidate uses the raw DynObj_FindSymbol_16 result.
Dword vs zero-extended word load at [ecx+0x1C]: retail `xor eax,eax; mov ax,word ...`; the candidate reads four bytes.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x005236C0 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/weatherwatersky/005236C0-WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0.cpp (sha256 1f4dd9ea76f631af54599bca4ef4d75ef7a3315372466fae172aff9aaeb19ca6). 15 blocks / 22 edges 0x5236C0-0x5237DC: remove the object at [E+4] from the dynobj list, clear/release the light pointer at [obj+0xC8], walk the lightmap list at [obj+0x88] (stride 0x24) sampling and clearing each entry, dispatch through the 0x180-stride handler table g_a96ae0 with the byte index g_547f3d masked by 0xFF and the WORD at [frame+0x1C], then update the lightmap free list (g_a83a08/g_a83a04/g_a83a14) and optionally unload 0xA83B54. Candidate: WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0 transcribes the whole body, but uses the full dword of g_547f3d for the dispatch index and reads a dword at [ecx+0x1C] where retail reads a zero-extended word.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail uses three register arguments (EAX/EDX/ECX) and one stack argument at [E+4]; BN models `int32_t __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, int32_t* arg3, void* arg4)`. The candidate declares the same regparm prototype and uses arg3 (ECX) as the local copy and arg4 ([E+4]) as the object pointer.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: arg1/arg2 are unused by the body; arg3 arrives in ECX and is copied into var_4; arg4 at [E+4] is the object whose fields 0x88/0xC8/0x14/0x74 are walked. The candidate's uses match those slots.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 15 blocks / 22 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 24 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false. The angr block-count difference is a granularity artifact of CFGFast splitting at call returns / rep movsd; the BN and radare2 block and edge tables are identical.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: DynObj_RemoveSymbol_7 (0x4C6840), Light_SetLightColor_2 (0x523670), Light_SampleLightmap_2 (0x5237E0), DynObj_FindSymbol_16 (0x4CFC80), Light_LightmapsRes (0x5210E0, twice), Sys_CheckHeap_16 (0x4B64E0) and Resource_Unload (0x4B6380) all match the retail callee addresses.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Retail masks the dispatch index with `and eax,0xff` (0x523738) before the 0x180-stride table multiply; the candidate uses the unmasked DynObj_FindSymbol_16 result.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Retail loads the table index with `xor eax,eax; mov ax, word [ecx+0x1c]` (zero-extended 16-bit load); the candidate reads a full dword at [ecx+0x1C], so the upper half of the frame word is not discarded.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Both return the decremented g_a83a08 value, or Resource_Unload's result on the unload path.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, int32_t* arg3, void* arg4)" at 0x005236C0; radare2 recovers "fcn.005236c0 (int32_t arg_14h, int32_t arg_74h, int32_t arg_88h, int32_t arg_c8h, int32_t arg_10h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x005236C0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t __convention WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, int32_t* param_3, void* param_4);.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate defines WeatherWaterSky_Invoke7_5236C0; the catalog name matches.
angr CFGFast reports 24 blocks against BN/radare2's 15; the extra angr nodes come from splitting blocks at call returns, not from real branches.
